claim_text: ALCE cites at the granularity of short hundred-word passages
quote:
Unlike commercial search assistants that cite an entire web page, ALCE cites at
the granularity of short hundred-word passages, because smaller passages are
easier for a human to verify against the claim.

claim_text: an intermediary paper propagates citation distortion downstream, drifting further with each hop
quote:
We find a telephone effect: when an intermediary paper cites an original source
with low fidelity, downstream papers that cite the intermediary inherit and
propagate that distortion, drifting further from the original claim with each hop.
